newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Napocor cuts power price in northern Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Napocor cuts power price in northern Philippines.

text.p: The Philippine's National Power Corp (Napocor) said on Monday it has lowered power rates in the main island of Luzon by 3.3 centavos per kilowatt-hour (kw/h).
Napocor said in a statement the lower cost of coal and geothermal steam pushed prices in the Luzon grid down to 2.2757 pesos per kwh from last month's 2.3087 per kwh.

Napocor tariff division manager Edgardo Orencia said the weakening of the peso had "minimal" effect on the power firm's rates. He said the central bank had allowed the power firm to draw from its dollar deposits with the bank to service its foreign debts.
There will be no changes in the four other grids in central and southern Philippines.
The Philippines' biggest power generation firm adjusts rates on a monthly basis to reflect changes in crude cost and foreign exchange fluctuation.
